static_traits.name: 方美琳
static_traits.social_status: 有少数朋友可倾诉，但对方not完全理解其Anxiety；近来因Anxiety而与亲友疏离
static_traits.medical_history: without显著躯体疾病；without既往心理咨询/治疗经历；deny以往类似心理问题
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰连贯，合作度高；能辨识并描述自身Anxiety与without助；有一定自我Reflection能力；情绪紧张但可被引导，态度积极

basic_info.main_problem: 因have not大学学历而害怕会永远被困在Barista的工作上，这种担忧带来Persistent anxiety与压力。
basic_info.core_demands: 希望管理并减轻与工作相关的Anxiety，挑战对not yet来的消极预测，重构思维，设定并推进小而具体的目标（如在线课程与行业内社交），拓展Career development的可能性。
growth_experiences: High school graduate后决定not读大学，最初影响not大，但随着时间推移，因看到同龄人事业进展而逐步加重对自身职业停滞的担忧与Self-doubt。
多次求职或探索其他工作机会not yet获成功，屡遭挫败感Reinforcement了“被困住”的体验，增加了对not yet来的Anxiety与without力感。
频繁接触到标注“需大学学位”的招聘信息，trigger强烈的自卑与without望感，形成对学历与职业前景的负向联结。

core_beliefs: have not大学学历就have not前途

special_situations.event: Sees job postings marked 'university degree required'
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我have not大学学位，就without法获得更好的工作和not yet来
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces applications or procrastinates applying, repeatedly worries and avoids further job-seeking actions
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will be stuck in this job forever

special_situations.event: Sees peers or friends making progress in their careers
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If peers move faster and better, it means I am behind and a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Distant from friends and family, avoiding talking about work and career topics
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我not如他们，我已经失败了

special_situations.event: 求职尝试遭到拒绝或not yet获回应
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 几次失败就意味着我以后也not会成功
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 降低尝试频率、Withdrawal并Self-denial以避免进一步失望
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我总是失败，我have not机会改变

special_situations.event: 回想自己多年一直做Barista且have not明显晋升
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果长期have not进展，就说明以后也not可能改变
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 维持现状、避免探索更具挑战的新路径以减少not确定性带来的Anxiety
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 已经太晚了，我not可能翻盘

core_conflict.wish: 渴望摆脱被困感，获得Career development与他人认可
core_conflict.fear: 害怕因学历与能力not足而持续Being rejected、被比较与被贬低
defense_goal: Reduces the pain of failure and being evaluated through distancing and avoidance
Lowers expectations to avoid being hurt again

object_relations.self_representation: A person left behind, lacking competitiveness
object_relations.object_representation: Peers/others who move faster, with a comparative and judgmental flavor
善意但without法真正理解的支持者（朋友/家人）

manifestations: 强烈的“被困住”体验，认为have not学历就without法选择与改变
在面对“需学位”的招聘信息时感到without力与受限
outcomes: 求职与行动上的回避与Withdrawal

manifestations: 因工作相关Anxiety而主动与朋友和家人疏离
感觉朋友虽在但“not太理解”自己的处境
outcomes: Self-care and regular eating further deteriorating

positive_force: Positive attitude, willing to seek help and engage in counseling
能觉察并表达自动化消极想法，具备初步的自我Reflection能力
意识到自身工作skill与经验的价值，愿意通过在线课程与行业内社交拓展机会
Has some social support (a few friends to confide in)
negative_force: 灾难化、过度概括与预测not yet来的思维模式Reinforcementwithout助感
对学历与not yet来前景的僵化信念（将“without学历=without前途”）
回避与Withdrawal行为（减少投递、疏离社交）短期缓解Anxiety但维持问题
多次求职挫折导致Self-efficacy与希望感下降
Disordered daily self-care and eating further weaken the capacity to act

target_behavior.behavior: 对职业前景的Persistent anxiety与灾难化思维，并伴随Social avoidance与自我照料下降
antecedent: Seeing job postings requiring a college degree
Seeing peers promoted or achieving success
Recalls the fact of having stayed in the same position for a long time
求职尝试被拒或not yet获回应
target_behavior.core_reason: 将“without大学学历=have not前途/without法改变”的僵化信念内化，反复以灾难化方式解读现实线索，导致without助与Withdrawal
target_behavior.function: 逃避Being rejected与被负面评价所带来的痛苦，短期降低Anxiety与not确定感
target_behavior.consequence: 求职与skill提升的实际行动减少；Work performance affected；与亲友疏离；饮食与自我照料变差，进而维持并加重Anxiety循环
